title: Samuel Hears God
summary: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Samuel 3:1-10 and look for how this passage teaches: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.

tell_it: Samuel heard his name at night and learned that the Lord was speaking. He answered with a listening heart.
understand_it: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Samuel Hears God reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Listening matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Samuel Hears God shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.
teen_explanation: Samuel Hears God gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when listening is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Samuel say to the Lord?
choices: Speak, for Your servant is listening
quiz_questions.answer: Speak, for Your servant is listening
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Speak, for Your servant is listening. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember 1 Samuel 3:10 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Samuel Hears God?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Listening Ears
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Listening to God matters, and even young people can respond to Him.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Samuel Hears God. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
